## 3. Daily use  _(Chapter)_

- **Download** (`Command`) — paste a link · pick linked pages
- **Publish** (`Command`) — the first heading becomes the title

### Commands

```
Download Page
  1. Paste the link
  2. Choose linked pages
Publish Page
  1. Open the file
  2. Confirm the overwrite when the page changed
```
